name: Pork Chops with Peach Salsa
description: Spiced, butter-basted pork chops served over a bright peach and jalapeño salsa.

itemListElement.text: Dice peaches, red bell pepper, and red onion. Seed and mince jalapeño.
Toss with cilantro, the juice of a lime, and a pinch of salt. Add a small drizzle of honey if the fruit isn't very sweet. Let it sit while you cook the chops.
Pat pork chops dry. Season generously with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, and garlic powder. Let them sit at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high. Sear the chops without moving them until deeply browned, 4-5 minutes per side.
In the last minute, add butter and spoon it over the chops. Pull them at 140°F; they'll rise to 145°F as they rest.
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon the salsa onto each plate, lay a chop on top, and pour the resting juices over it. Serve with wedges of lime.
For a light glaze, brush a little honey on the chops with the butter in the last minute. Watch closely, since honey burns fast.
